cues.en: In this chapter, we want to have a look at how you can connect to a remote server through SSH.
The idea is that we can use the SSH protocol to connect to this remote server and this allows us then
to control the remote server.
We could, for example, use a terminal then on the remote server, but we could also transfer files
and if we would set it up properly, we could even use interactive user interface applications there.
But usually we only use SSH to either create or open a remote terminal or to just transfer files.
This chapter is important for you.
If you want to be the sysadmin of a server or if you are the sysadmin of a server and you want to connect
to that server remotely.
Or if you are a web developer and you just want to deploy your application to your own server, a lot
of even affordable web hosting plans offer SSH access and this allows you to open a terminal on your
web hoster and then you can just easily deploy your website, for example, from GitHub and you can
just clone that repository just through a normal shell.
Another reason why you or why SSH is important is that even if you use tools that could abstract the
need for SSH, sometimes you need to debug something.
So for example, if you use tools like Docker or Kubernetes to manage your cluster and then a problem
happens and you need to manually connect to a server to debug that problem, then you also need SSH.
So even if you use tools that usually would abstract this SSH away from you, you still need to know
it if any problems happen or you want, for example, to use a small computer without a display.
So for example a Raspberry Pi or something like this and you don't want a display to be connected to
that one.
And then the easiest way to control that computer would be through SSH.
So this chapter here is really useful whenever you want to connect to another computer and control it.
But this chapter is more than just this theory.
You will also learn how you can secure the server.
So to minimize the attack surface there and you will learn how you can connect with a private key instead
of a password.
This further improves the security of your server and you will also learn how to prevent annoying disconnects.
So, for example, usually with a default configuration, for example, when you would leave for a coffee
break and then you would come back, the connection might be dropped.
And that's really annoying because you were just working there and then your documents on the remote
server are no longer open.
You need to create your environment again.
And so I will also tell you or teach you how you can prevent that to make sure you overall have a smooth
experience with SSH.
So.
So let's now start to have a look at SSH and how all of that works.
